description: Microsoft 365 service health inside YOUR tenant (with your read-only Graph token): degraded services and every open incident or advisory with impact, status and timestamps, optionally for one service (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint...). Needs ServiceHealth.Read.All. Token never stored. Costs $0.02 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

graph_token.description: MCP only: your Microsoft Graph access token (read-only app registration; see https://microsoft.l50automation.com/microsoft/tenant-setup). Over HTTP send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer' header instead. Used once, never stored or logged.

service.description: Optional service name filter, e.g. Exchange, Teams, SharePoint
